variables.name: eVar2

variables.name: eVar3
variables.description: Business unit / brand owning the page — constant 'Heritage SG — SNF' for this property.

variables.name: Marketing Channel

variables.name: eVar4

variables.name: eVar5
variables.description: Registered (email-verified) vs. unregistered visitor state. Serves BRD 201-203, 1603.

variables.name: eVar6

variables.name: eVar7
variables.description: Human-readable page name. Serves BRD 101, 104, 802.

variables.name: eVar8
variables.description: Top-level site section (programme, installations, trails, map, info). Serves BRD 101, 104.

variables.name: eVar9
variables.description: Template/page-type classifier (listing, detail, policy, map, trails). Serves BRD 104, 107, 108, 1812.

variables.name: eVar10
variables.description: Flag confirming standard government disclaimer rendered on page. Serves BRD 106.

variables.name: eVar11
variables.description: Flag capturing Heritage SG brand-guideline compliance state per page. Serves BRD 109, 1304, 1403.

variables.name: eVar12
variables.description: Unique AEMaaCS identifier of the viewed programme or installation. Serves BRD 104, 602, 604, 803.

variables.name: eVar13
variables.description: Display title of programme/installation. Serves BRD 104.

variables.name: eVar14
variables.description: Venue associated with the programme/installation. Serves BRD 104, 401, 405, 1405.

variables.name: eVar15
variables.description: Scheduled date and time window of the programme/installation. Serves BRD 104, 701.

variables.name: eVar16
variables.description: Whether QR-gated unlocked content is present and whether it was unlocked for this visitor. Serves BRD 602, 605, 1104.

variables.name: eVar17
variables.description: AEMaaCS firstFestivalYear content field for returning-vs-new programme analysis. Serves BRD 1104.

variables.name: eVar18
variables.description: Destination of off-site CTAs, primarily the Klook ticketing link. Serves BRD 105.

variables.name: eVar19
variables.description: Type of MapBox interaction (pin-tap, zoom, filter, directions). Serves BRD 401, 402, 1201.

variables.name: eVar20

variables.description: Display name of the trail. Serves BRD 501, 507.

variables.name: eVar25

variables.name: eVar26

variables.name: eVar27

variables.name: eVar28

variables.name: eVar29

variables.name: eVar30
variables.description: Context that triggered a registration prompt (first QR scan, itinerary adoption, profile). Serves BRD 603, 506, 1205.

variables.name: eVar31
variables.description: Three-tier consent state (Tier0 Functional / Tier1 Festival Marketing / Tier2 Year-Round NHB). Serves BRD 301, 302, 303, 1204.

variables.name: eVar32
variables.description: Cookie consent categories accepted (Strictly Necessary / Analytics & Performance / Personalisation & Targeting). Serves BRD 1808, 1809, 1810, 1811.

variables.name: eVar33
variables.description: Derived student-cohort flag from geo cluster, visit timing and referral — not stored as permanent PII, refreshed annually. Serves BRD 1806.

variables.name: eVar34
variables.description: Adobe Target activity and experience served for personalisation use cases. Serves BRD 701-706, 1203.

variables.name: eVar35
variables.description: Session-hash cluster used for 'Trending with your circle' signal. Non-PII derived cluster. Serves BRD 703.

variables.name: eVar36
variables.description: Classified visitor intent within Brand Concierge (programme discovery, trail rec, venue info, general). Serves BRD 1405, 1406.

variables.name: eVar37
variables.description: Resolution outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction (resolved, escalated, failed). Serves BRD 1406.

variables.name: eVar38
variables.description: AI/agentic crawler or GEO/LLMO traffic source attribution. Serves BRD 901, 902, 1302, 1303.

variables.name: list1
variables.description: Multi-value list of programme/installation IDs composing a custom itinerary on a single hit. Delimiter '|'. Serves BRD 503, 504.

variables.name: Full Page URL. Mirrors The Page URL
variables.description: Full page URL. Mirrors the Page URL eVar to enable PathFinder/next-page flow analysis. Baseline mandatory variable.

variables.name: Business Unit Mirrored To Prop For
variables.description: Business unit mirrored to prop for section-pathing. Baseline mandatory variable.

variables.name: Programme/installation Content Title
variables.description: Programme/installation content title mirrored from the Content Title eVar. Enables page-flow pathing across festival programme and installation listings (BRD 104).

variables.name: Site Section Mirrored To Prop For
variables.description: Site section (programme, installation, trails, map, info) mirrored to prop for section-to-section pathing analysis (BRD 104).

variables.name: Legal/compliance Page Type Mirrored To
variables.description: Legal/compliance page type (privacy-policy, terms-of-use, cookie-policy, gov-disclaimer) mirrored to prop for compliance-page pathing (BRD 106/107/108/1812).

variables.name: Off-site CTA Destination Mirrored To
variables.description: Off-site CTA destination (e.g. Klook ticketing) mirrored to prop for exit-flow pathing to off-site destinations (BRD 105).

variables.name: Installation / Qr-coded Asset ID
variables.description: Installation / QR-coded asset ID mirrored to prop for QR check-in sequence pathing across venues (BRD 601/604).

variables.name: Trail Name Mirrored From The Trail Evar
variables.description: Trail name mirrored from the Trail eVar for trail-selection/follow pathing analysis (BRD 501/502).

variables.name: Trail/itinerary Step Mirrored To Prop
variables.description: Trail/itinerary step mirrored to prop for check-in progress pathing (BRD 502). Supports funnel step sequencing via QR check-ins.

variables.name: Interactive Map Interaction Target
variables.description: Interactive map interaction target (venue/pin tapped) mirrored to prop for map-interaction pathing analysis (BRD 401/405).

variables.name: Brand Concierge Query Intent Mirrored
variables.description: Brand Concierge query intent mirrored to prop for conversation-intent sequence pathing (BRD 1405/1406).

variables.name: event1
variables.description: Baseline page-view counter fired on every page load across all SNF website pages and viewports (BRD 101/103).

variables.name: event2
variables.description: Baseline page load time in milliseconds (Numeric). Pairs with event3 to build the Avg Page Load Time calculated metric (BRD 1503/1504).

variables.name: event3
variables.description: Baseline counter of page load time measurement instances. Denominator for the Avg Page Load Time calculated metric (BRD 1503/1504).

variables.name: event4
variables.description: Fires when a festival programme or installation listing/detail is displayed (title, description, venue, dates, times) (BRD 104).

variables.name: event5
variables.description: Fires when QR-unlocked content (visible only to physically scanned-in visitors) is rendered on a programme detail page (BRD 602/605).

variables.name: event6
variables.description: Fires on Privacy Policy page views documenting PDPA data collection, purpose, retention and visitor rights (BRD 107).

variables.name: event7
variables.description: Fires on Terms of Use page views (BRD 108).

variables.name: event8
variables.description: Fires on Cookie Policy page views documenting all cookies, purpose, category and retention (BRD 1812).

variables.name: event9
variables.description: Fires when the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing visitors off-site is clicked (BRD 105).

variables.name: event10
variables.description: Fires on interaction with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pan/zoom/pin select) displaying programme and installation locations (BRD 401/402).

variables.name: event11
variables.description: Fires when a visitor grants location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings (BRD 403).

variables.name: event12
variables.description: Fires when a visitor denies location permission; default listing behaviour without degradation (BRD 404).

variables.name: event13
variables.description: Fires when an Adobe Target personalisation surface (Your picks tonight, Trending with your circle, returning-visitor banner) is displayed (BRD 702/703/704/706).

variables.name: event14
variables.description: Fires when a visitor clicks/engages an Adobe Target personalisation surface, enabling lift and conversion reporting (BRD 706/1203).

variables.name: event15
variables.description: Fires on each Brand Concierge query/interaction for engagement-rate and intent reporting (BRD 1405/1406).

variables.name: event16
variables.description: Fires when a Brand Concierge interaction escalates or fails to resolve, for failure-rate reporting (BRD 1406).

variables.name: event17
variables.description: Fires on a QR scan recorded against the registered visitor's profile as a confirmed check-in, capturing installation ID and timestamp (BRD 601/604/1803).

variables.name: event18
variables.description: Fires when the dismissible email registration prompt is shown on first QR scan by an unauthenticated visitor (BRD 603/1205).

variables.name: event19
variables.description: Fires when a curated self-guided trail is viewed for selection and navigation (BRD 501).

variables.name: event20
variables.description: Fires when a registered visitor saves and follows a trail with progress tracked via QR check-ins (BRD 502).

variables.name: event21
variables.description: Fires when a visitor adds a chosen programme or installation to a custom itinerary (BRD 503).

variables.name: event22
variables.description: Fires when a dismissible, non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion is surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies (BRD 504).

variables.name: event23
variables.description: Fires when a visitor shares an itinerary via native device share (no social OAuth) (BRD 505/705).

variables.name: event24
variables.description: Fires when a shared itinerary is viewed without authentication (BRD 506/705).

variables.name: event25
variables.description: Fires on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary; unique festival-window adoptions ≥10 surface Community Picks (BRD 506/507/705).

variables.name: event26
variables.description: Fires when a visitor begins the mobile-optimised email registration flow; funnel start for registration reporting (BRD 202/1205).

variables.name: event27
variables.description: Fires when email registration is verified via one-time code or link; funnel completion (BRD 201/202/1205).

variables.name: event28
variables.description: Fires when a visitor grants a consent tier (Tier 0/1/2) with positive action; feeds consent-tier distribution reporting and the consent log (BRD 301/302/304/1204).

variables.name: event29
variables.description: Fires on consent withdrawal via self-service profile settings, effective immediately (BRD 303/304).

variables.name: event30
variables.description: Fires when a visitor records a cookie consent choice (Strictly Necessary / Analytics & Performance / Personalisation & Targeting) via banner or settings (BRD 1808/1809/1810/1811).

metrics_segments.name: Production Data Only
metrics_segments.description: Restricts reporting to production environment hits where Environment eVar = 'production'. Mandatory baseline segment on every SDR.

metrics_segments.name: All Visits
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment capturing all visits to the site with no additional criteria. Used as the default reporting denominator.

metrics_segments.name: New Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Baseline OOTB segment isolating first-time visitors (New/Return Visitor = New).

metrics_segments.name: Returning Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Baseline OOTB segment isolating returning visitors (New/Return Visitor = Return).

metrics_segments.name: Authenticated Users
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment isolating registered/authenticated visitors (Login Status = logged-in). Supported by email registration requirements.

metrics_segments.name: Bounce Rate
metrics_segments.description: Baseline OOTB calculated metric: single-hit visits as a percentage of total visits.

metrics_segments.name: Conversion Rate
metrics_segments.description: Baseline calculated metric: registration completions divided by registration starts (or applicable success event over visits).

metrics_segments.name: Pages per Visit
metrics_segments.description: Baseline OOTB calculated metric: total page views divided by total visits.

metrics_segments.name: Mobile Viewport Sessions
metrics_segments.description: Visits delivered to a mobile viewport, derived from OOTB mobile device/viewport dimensions. Supports responsive mobile-first tracking (BRD 103, 202).

metrics_segments.name: Desktop Viewport Sessions
metrics_segments.description: Visits delivered to a desktop viewport, derived from OOTB device/viewport dimensions. Supports responsive delivery tracking (BRD 103).

metrics_segments.name: Tier 1 Festival Marketing Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 1 Festival Marketing consent at registration, from the consent eVar (BRD 301, 302).

metrics_segments.name: Tier 2 Year-Round NHB Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 2 Year-Round NHB consent at registration, from the consent eVar (BRD 301, 302).

metrics_segments.name: Consent Withdrawn
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who withdrew consent via self-service profile settings, from the consent action event/eVar (BRD 303, 304).

metrics_segments.name: Analytics Cookies Accepted
metrics_segments.description: Visits where the visitor accepted Analytics & Performance cookies via the PDPA cookie consent banner (BRD 1808, 1809, 1811).

metrics_segments.name: Registration Started
metrics_segments.description: Visits that fired the registration start event (BRD 201, 202, 1205).

metrics_segments.name: Registration Completed (Email Verified)
metrics_segments.description: Visits that completed email-verified registration via one-time code or link (BRD 201, 202).

metrics_segments.name: Registration Abandoned
metrics_segments.description: Visits with a registration start event but no completion, for funnel drop-off analysis (BRD 1205).

metrics_segments.name: QR-Triggered Registration Prompt
metrics_segments.description: Visits where the dismissible registration prompt was triggered by a first QR scan from an unauthenticated visitor (BRD 603, 1205).

metrics_segments.name: Visits With QR Check-in
metrics_segments.description: Visits with at least one confirmed QR check-in event capturing installation ID and timestamp (BRD 601, 604).

metrics_segments.name: Multi-Venue Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors with QR check-ins at more than one unique venue/installation (BRD 604).

metrics_segments.name: Unlocked Content Viewed
metrics_segments.description: Visits that viewed QR-scan-unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors (BRD 602, 605).

metrics_segments.name: Trail Followers
metrics_segments.description: Registered visitors who saved and followed a curated trail with QR check-in progress (BRD 501, 502).

metrics_segments.name: Custom Itinerary Creators
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding programmes and installations (BRD 503).

metrics_segments.name: Itinerary Shared
metrics_segments.description: Visits that shared an itinerary via native device share (BRD 505, 705).

metrics_segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who adopted a shared itinerary via one-tap adoption, triggering a light registration prompt (BRD 506, 507).

metrics_segments.name: Map Interaction Sessions
metrics_segments.description: Visits that interacted with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (BRD 401, 402).

metrics_segments.name: Location Permission Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visits where location permission was granted, enabling proximity-based sorting (BRD 403, 404).

metrics_segments.name: Returning Visitors With Open Itinerary
metrics_segments.description: Returning visitors with unvisited bookmarks or incomplete trail stops shown the contextual banner (BRD 704).

metrics_segments.name: Personalised Feed Engaged
metrics_segments.description: Visits that engaged with the 'Your picks tonight' affinity-matched feed or 'Trending with your circle' chip (BRD 702, 703, 706).

metrics_segments.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Clickers
metrics_segments.description: Visits that clicked the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site (BRD 105).

metrics_segments.name: Brand Concierge Engaged
metrics_segments.description: Visits that engaged with Adobe Brand Concierge, from the interaction event/intent eVar (BRD 1404, 1405, 1406).

metrics_segments.name: Brand Concierge Escalation / Failure
metrics_segments.description: Visits where a Brand Concierge interaction escalated or failed, for escalation/failure rate reporting (BRD 1406).

metrics_segments.name: Compliance Page Views
metrics_segments.description: Visits that viewed compliance pages (Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Cookie Policy, government disclaimer) (BRD 106, 107, 108, 1812).

props.label: Section A — OOTB / Standard (props mirror OOTB eVars; no custom slot required)
Section B — Custom Props (mirror an eVar; PathFinder / PatternMatch / ClickMap only)

props.name: prop1
props.description: Full page URL. Mirrors the Page URL eVar to enable PathFinder/next-page flow analysis. Baseline mandatory variable.

props.name: prop2
props.description: Business unit mirrored to prop for section-pathing. Baseline mandatory variable.

props.name: prop3
props.description: Programme/installation content title mirrored from the Content Title eVar. Enables page-flow pathing across festival programme and installation listings (BRD 104).

props.name: prop4
props.description: Site section (programme, installation, trails, map, info) mirrored to prop for section-to-section pathing analysis (BRD 104).

props.name: prop5
props.description: Legal/compliance page type (privacy-policy, terms-of-use, cookie-policy, gov-disclaimer) mirrored to prop for compliance-page pathing (BRD 106/107/108/1812).

props.name: prop6
props.description: Off-site CTA destination (e.g. Klook ticketing) mirrored to prop for exit-flow pathing to off-site destinations (BRD 105).

props.name: prop7
props.description: Installation / QR-coded asset ID mirrored to prop for QR check-in sequence pathing across venues (BRD 601/604).

props.name: prop8
props.description: Trail name mirrored from the Trail eVar for trail-selection/follow pathing analysis (BRD 501/502).

props.name: prop9
props.description: Trail/itinerary step mirrored to prop for check-in progress pathing (BRD 502). Supports funnel step sequencing via QR check-ins.

props.name: prop10
props.description: Interactive map interaction target (venue/pin tapped) mirrored to prop for map-interaction pathing analysis (BRD 401/405).

props.name: prop11
props.description: Brand Concierge query intent mirrored to prop for conversation-intent sequence pathing (BRD 1405/1406).

events.name: event1
events.description: Baseline page-view counter fired on every page load across all SNF website pages and viewports (BRD 101/103).

events.name: event2
events.description: Baseline page load time in milliseconds (Numeric). Pairs with event3 to build the Avg Page Load Time calculated metric (BRD 1503/1504).

events.name: event3
events.description: Baseline counter of page load time measurement instances. Denominator for the Avg Page Load Time calculated metric (BRD 1503/1504).

events.name: event4
events.description: Fires when a festival programme or installation listing/detail is displayed (title, description, venue, dates, times) (BRD 104).

events.name: event5
events.description: Fires when QR-unlocked content (visible only to physically scanned-in visitors) is rendered on a programme detail page (BRD 602/605).

events.name: event6
events.description: Fires on Privacy Policy page views documenting PDPA data collection, purpose, retention and visitor rights (BRD 107).

events.name: event7
events.description: Fires on Terms of Use page views (BRD 108).

events.name: event8
events.description: Fires on Cookie Policy page views documenting all cookies, purpose, category and retention (BRD 1812).

events.name: event9
events.description: Fires when the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing visitors off-site is clicked (BRD 105).

events.name: event10
events.description: Fires on interaction with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pan/zoom/pin select) displaying programme and installation locations (BRD 401/402).

events.name: event11
events.description: Fires when a visitor grants location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings (BRD 403).

events.name: event12
events.description: Fires when a visitor denies location permission; default listing behaviour without degradation (BRD 404).

events.name: event13
events.description: Fires when an Adobe Target personalisation surface (Your picks tonight, Trending with your circle, returning-visitor banner) is displayed (BRD 702/703/704/706).

events.name: event14
events.description: Fires when a visitor clicks/engages an Adobe Target personalisation surface, enabling lift and conversion reporting (BRD 706/1203).

events.name: event15
events.description: Fires on each Brand Concierge query/interaction for engagement-rate and intent reporting (BRD 1405/1406).

events.name: event16
events.description: Fires when a Brand Concierge interaction escalates or fails to resolve, for failure-rate reporting (BRD 1406).

events.name: event17
events.description: Fires on a QR scan recorded against the registered visitor's profile as a confirmed check-in, capturing installation ID and timestamp (BRD 601/604/1803).

events.name: event18
events.description: Fires when the dismissible email registration prompt is shown on first QR scan by an unauthenticated visitor (BRD 603/1205).

events.name: event19
events.description: Fires when a curated self-guided trail is viewed for selection and navigation (BRD 501).

events.name: event20
events.description: Fires when a registered visitor saves and follows a trail with progress tracked via QR check-ins (BRD 502).

events.name: event21
events.description: Fires when a visitor adds a chosen programme or installation to a custom itinerary (BRD 503).

events.name: event22
events.description: Fires when a dismissible, non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion is surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies (BRD 504).

events.name: event23
events.description: Fires when a visitor shares an itinerary via native device share (no social OAuth) (BRD 505/705).

events.name: event24
events.description: Fires when a shared itinerary is viewed without authentication (BRD 506/705).

events.name: event25
events.description: Fires on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary; unique festival-window adoptions ≥10 surface Community Picks (BRD 506/507/705).
events.unique_recording: Yes (unique per visitor per itinerary within festival window)

events.name: event26
events.description: Fires when a visitor begins the mobile-optimised email registration flow; funnel start for registration reporting (BRD 202/1205).

events.name: event27
events.description: Fires when email registration is verified via one-time code or link; funnel completion (BRD 201/202/1205).

events.name: event28
events.description: Fires when a visitor grants a consent tier (Tier 0/1/2) with positive action; feeds consent-tier distribution reporting and the consent log (BRD 301/302/304/1204).

events.name: event29
events.description: Fires on consent withdrawal via self-service profile settings, effective immediately (BRD 303/304).

events.name: event30
events.description: Fires when a visitor records a cookie consent choice (Strictly Necessary / Analytics & Performance / Personalisation & Targeting) via banner or settings (BRD 1808/1809/1810/1811).

segments.name: Production Data Only
segments.description: Restricts reporting to production environment hits where Environment eVar = 'production'. Mandatory baseline segment on every SDR.

segments.name: All Visits
segments.description: Baseline segment capturing all visits to the site with no additional criteria. Used as the default reporting denominator.

segments.name: New Visitors
segments.description: Baseline OOTB segment isolating first-time visitors (New/Return Visitor = New).

segments.name: Returning Visitors
segments.description: Baseline OOTB segment isolating returning visitors (New/Return Visitor = Return).

segments.name: Authenticated Users
segments.description: Baseline segment isolating registered/authenticated visitors (Login Status = logged-in). Supported by email registration requirements.

segments.name: Bounce Rate
segments.description: Baseline OOTB calculated metric: single-hit visits as a percentage of total visits.

segments.name: Conversion Rate
segments.description: Baseline calculated metric: registration completions divided by registration starts (or applicable success event over visits).

segments.name: Pages per Visit
segments.description: Baseline OOTB calculated metric: total page views divided by total visits.

segments.name: Mobile Viewport Sessions
segments.description: Visits delivered to a mobile viewport, derived from OOTB mobile device/viewport dimensions. Supports responsive mobile-first tracking (BRD 103, 202).

segments.name: Desktop Viewport Sessions
segments.description: Visits delivered to a desktop viewport, derived from OOTB device/viewport dimensions. Supports responsive delivery tracking (BRD 103).

segments.name: Tier 1 Festival Marketing Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 1 Festival Marketing consent at registration, from the consent eVar (BRD 301, 302).

segments.name: Tier 2 Year-Round NHB Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 2 Year-Round NHB consent at registration, from the consent eVar (BRD 301, 302).

segments.name: Consent Withdrawn
segments.description: Visitors who withdrew consent via self-service profile settings, from the consent action event/eVar (BRD 303, 304).

segments.name: Analytics Cookies Accepted
segments.description: Visits where the visitor accepted Analytics & Performance cookies via the PDPA cookie consent banner (BRD 1808, 1809, 1811).

segments.name: Registration Started
segments.description: Visits that fired the registration start event (BRD 201, 202, 1205).

segments.name: Registration Completed (Email Verified)
segments.description: Visits that completed email-verified registration via one-time code or link (BRD 201, 202).

segments.name: Registration Abandoned
segments.description: Visits with a registration start event but no completion, for funnel drop-off analysis (BRD 1205).

segments.name: QR-Triggered Registration Prompt
segments.description: Visits where the dismissible registration prompt was triggered by a first QR scan from an unauthenticated visitor (BRD 603, 1205).

segments.name: Visits With QR Check-in
segments.description: Visits with at least one confirmed QR check-in event capturing installation ID and timestamp (BRD 601, 604).

segments.name: Multi-Venue Visitors
segments.description: Visitors with QR check-ins at more than one unique venue/installation (BRD 604).

segments.name: Unlocked Content Viewed
segments.description: Visits that viewed QR-scan-unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors (BRD 602, 605).

segments.name: Trail Followers
segments.description: Registered visitors who saved and followed a curated trail with QR check-in progress (BRD 501, 502).

segments.name: Custom Itinerary Creators
segments.description: Visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding programmes and installations (BRD 503).

segments.name: Itinerary Shared
segments.description: Visits that shared an itinerary via native device share (BRD 505, 705).

segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
segments.description: Visitors who adopted a shared itinerary via one-tap adoption, triggering a light registration prompt (BRD 506, 507).

segments.name: Map Interaction Sessions
segments.description: Visits that interacted with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (BRD 401, 402).

segments.name: Location Permission Granted
segments.description: Visits where location permission was granted, enabling proximity-based sorting (BRD 403, 404).

segments.name: Returning Visitors With Open Itinerary
segments.description: Returning visitors with unvisited bookmarks or incomplete trail stops shown the contextual banner (BRD 704).

segments.name: Personalised Feed Engaged
segments.description: Visits that engaged with the 'Your picks tonight' affinity-matched feed or 'Trending with your circle' chip (BRD 702, 703, 706).

segments.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Clickers
segments.description: Visits that clicked the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site (BRD 105).

segments.name: Brand Concierge Engaged
segments.description: Visits that engaged with Adobe Brand Concierge, from the interaction event/intent eVar (BRD 1404, 1405, 1406).

segments.name: Brand Concierge Escalation / Failure
segments.description: Visits where a Brand Concierge interaction escalated or failed, for escalation/failure rate reporting (BRD 1406).

segments.name: Compliance Page Views
segments.description: Visits that viewed compliance pages (Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Cookie Policy, government disclaimer) (BRD 106, 107, 108, 1812).
